text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (September 11, 2025) for 64 St. Clair Avenue West.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (September 11, 2025) for 64 St. Clair Avenue West, Folder Number 25 224227 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to October 30, 2026.
